name: dsh-track
description: Keep a task's state across context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: the model writes a checkpoint and the plugin re-injects it into the system prompt after every compaction. Checkpoints stay in the plugin's own folder, never in your workspace.

summary.en: Keep a task's state across context compaction: the model writes a checkpoint, and the plugin re-injects it into the system prompt after every compaction, so conclusions survive repeated summarisation. Checkpoints stay in the plugin's own folder, never in your workspace.
summary.zh: 让任务状态熬过上下文压缩：模型写入检查点，插件在每次压缩后把它重新注入系统提示词，结论不会被一轮轮摘要冲掉。检查点存在插件自有目录，绝不写入你的工作区。

author: Saretheya
